description: arcade-social's own pages and public JSON, from the real server run against the test suite's fake UserAuth with demo accounts (snapshot.py).

shots.name: signin
shots.caption: Sign in: the only page a password is typed into. No script, inline CSS only.
shots.alt: The arcade-social sign-in page on a phone: username and password fields, a Sign in button and a link to create an account

shots.name: signin-error
shots.caption: A refused sign-in, as UserAuth answered it.
shots.alt: The sign-in page showing a red error message above the username and password fields

shots.name: register
shots.caption: Create an account (stored by UserAuth, not here).
shots.alt: The create-account page on a phone with username, password and confirm-password fields

shots.name: welcome
shots.caption: First sign-in: choose the display name shown on leaderboards.
shots.alt: The choose-a-display-name page on a phone with a single name field and a Save button

shots.name: account
shots.caption: Account: the private username, the display name, what is held, the hall-presence toggle and delete.
shots.alt: The account page on a phone: signed in as a demo user, counts of scores, achievements and likes, a Show me in the hall button and a Delete my data form

shots.name: saves
shots.caption: Cloud saves: the newest versions per game, each a download, with a typed delete.
shots.alt: The cloud saves page on a phone listing three FishE save versions from two browsers, each with a Download link, and a delete form

shots.name: account-dark
shots.caption: The pages follow the system dark mode.
shots.alt: The account page in dark mode on a phone

shots.name: api
shots.caption: Real JSON from three public reads: a leaderboard (always "verified": false), achievement percentages and like counts.
shots.alt: Dark terminal-style panel with JSON responses for the FishE most-money leaderboard, FishE achievements and like counts

shots.alt: The top of the sign in page on a phone

shots.alt: The top of the account page on a phone
